rules.height_reference: Median of previously accepted heights at f-30 <= prior_frame < f. During startup use global player/point median until accepted evidence spans >=8 source frames (original five 2F samples). If rolling history is empty, use global median.
rules.height_reset: Consecutive raw height rejections, missing raw samples do not break run (056 rule). Retrospectively reconsider run, replace height history, retain speed rejection from previous accepted and adjacent raw points, including entry/return.
rules.smoothing: Separate, frozen-input x/y medians in inclusive +/-8F window in runs with accepted gaps <=30F. Window must span >=4F (original three 2F samples); no recursive updates, one-sided end windows allowed.
rules.interpolation: Linear between smoothed accepted endpoints, every source frame. status is final; filter_status preserves rejection before interpolation.
rules.wrist: Both same-side players need >=1 finite nonnegative wrist_speed. Unique larger peak >=1.3*smaller; both zero/ties undecided. No guessed replacement.
rules.side_outside: Consecutive source frames, no bridging missing values; duration=(end-start)/59.94 >=1. Report cleaned positions and raw proxies separately over full exported point span.

pose_supplement.fallback_torso_scope: each 26-frame supplement interval/player, using the existing function

pose_retrack.scope: all 32 shots checked; both same-side players for changed shot windows, -15..+10F inclusive
pose_retrack.fallback_torso_scope: per 26-frame window and player, as existing wrist_timeseries
